confess.label: // CONFESS YOUR PROMPT
confess.intro: Write your own prompt the way the artist wrote his: concepts only. No faces, no bodies, no names. The Curator will tell you which face the latent space would converge on.
confess.placeholder: A tangent diverging toward infinity; the fractal edge where faith outweighs physics…

rejected.label: // REFUSED
rejected.fallback: This prompt describes a body, not a concept.
rejected.hint: Try again with concepts alone — no physical description, no names.

confess.shareTitle: The Latent Liturgy — the face my prompt attracts

error.generic: The latent space did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error.rate: The latent space is still resolving. Wait {seconds} s.
error.daily: You have confessed enough for today. Return tomorrow.

voice.hint: Hold the button, speak, release. The Curator answers aloud.

error.denied: Microphone access was refused. The ritual needs your voice.
